adidas Men's Shoes

This collection of adidas men’s shoes brings you athletic shoes for top performance as well as casual footwear that looks and feels great all day. Lace up in basketball shoes designed for sprints, pivots and quick lateral movements on the hardwood. adidas running shoes for men with midsoles featuring adidas boost cushion every step and provide energy return, propelling you forward on your daily runs. If you like to mix things up, cross-trainers are ready to hit the gym for cardio classes and strength training. Breathable uppers allow airflow to help keep your feet dry, even during intense sessions, and durable rubber outsoles provide traction and stability so you can maximize your efforts.

This collection of men’s adidas footwear also includes classic looks and fresh styles for everyday wear. Choose an iconic Samba sneaker with contrasting 3-Stripes and a gum rubber outsole that easily transitions from the office to a post-work meetup at the local gathering spot. Handball Spezial shoes offer a versatile, low-profile look that can work with jeans, shorts or track pants. Choose neutral colors like black or beige for a versatile option that goes with all of your clothes, or opt for bold, bright colors to add a pop to your favorite outfits. Gear up for your fitness routine and your day-to-day in adidas men’s shoes.

Men's Shoes Frequently Asked Questions

One of adidas' most iconic shoes is the Superstar. This classic sneaker, characterized by its distinctive rubber shell toe, has been a staple in sneaker culture for decades. It has transcended generations and continues to be a popular choice for men and women alike. adidas shoes for men, including the Superstar, offer a blend of style, comfort, and performance.
For ultimate comfort in adidas men's shoes, the Ultraboost series consistently ranks high. Its innovative Boost midsole technology provides exceptional cushioning and energy return, making it a top choice for both running and casual wear. The Primeknit upper offers a sock-like fit, further enhancing comfort.
When looking for men's shoes for everyday use, the adidas Stan Smith is a timeless classic. Its sleek, minimalist design, comfortable leather upper, and versatile style make it a perfect choice for casual wear. It's comfortable, stylish, and can be paired with a variety of outfits.
